text: Love.
Falling in love with someone, confessing to them, and then being with them... These are all things that no doubt everyone hopes to experience for themselves.
Such a naive mindset!
There's always the exploiter and the exploited, the master and the servant, the winner and the loser. That's the truth of love. Love is, in fact, a war!
The pinnacle duo of Shuchiin Academy, student council president Miyuki Shirogane and vice president Kaguya Shinomiya, are not oblivious about the nature of love.
The one who falls in love first loses! The heated battle of wits between geniuses doesn't seem to have lost its flair just yet...
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Hayasaka, are you sure about this intel?
{character:Ai Hayasaka}Affirmative. According to our intel, the president has recently been going to the shrine through these stairs every day after school.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(I don't think we have any upcoming tests, so why does he look so tired?)

{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(Since you're reluctant to tell the truth, don't blame me for invading your privacy. Hehehe... I swear to find out what the president is hiding from me in the name of Shinomiya.)
Kaguya Shinomiya's words can't conceal her desire. Her curiosity could almost kill every cat on earth.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Hold up. Something doesn't add up. Hayasaka, you're telling me that there's a shrine here?
{character:Ai Hayasaka}I don't remember seeing one. It seems like it's always been here, but for some reason, I've never noticed it before...
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}This place seems sketchy to me. Could it be?! Don't tell me the president's financial situation has gone so bad that he's gotten wrapped up in something hideous?!
{character:Ai Hayasaka}My lady, I'd say you're more dangerous for being able to make such an absurd assumption so easily... Let's head inside first. We'll lose him if we keep dilly-dallying.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}...Hayasaka, what are those people doing?
{character:Ai Hayasaka}Exactly what it looks like they're doing. They're playing Mahjong.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Gosh, Captain Obvious! I'm just curious why so many people are gathered here at the shrine for Mahjong?
Upon entering the shrine, Kaguya and Ai are awed by the sight of Mahjong tables filling the yard.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}That's supposed to be my line. Mr. President, what are you doing here?

{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Isn't that obvious? I'm working here. I stumbled upon this shrine some time ago, and I saw that they were recruiting part-timers for organizing an event to promote some new rules. And since I have some time, why not?
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Now that explains... As if you aren't having sleep issues already. Wouldn't it be overwhelming to juggle another job?
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Well, it's just a temporary job. I think I'll be fine.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Since you have thought this through, I guess there's nothing more for me to say. Let's head back, Hayasaka.
{character:Ai Hayasaka}My bad, looks like I won with a Ron!
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}When did you start playing...?
{character:Ai Hayasaka}I watched on the sidelines for a while and found the special rules pretty interesting. Since we're here already, how about a game or two, Miss Kaguya?
Kaguya looks at the board Ai has pointed to not far away. She moves closer to have a look and nods with something in mind.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Interesting or not... Things like “Destiny Cards” somehow make me think that a particular person is behind this.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Bingo. According to the shrine's official, this game is inspired by an anonymous pink-headed lady.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}I knew it. These rules were designed by none other than Secretary Fujiwara... That's my cue to leave. Ciao!
The rules might be interesting, but it is definitely not enough to make Kaguya stay. She has no interest in staying after fulfilling her purpose.
{character:Ichihime}We're back! Nyaa!
{character:Kei Shirogane}We're back. Work hard, Miyuki? Miss Shinomiya?! Why are you here?
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Kei? Don't tell me you're working here, too?
{character:Kei Shirogane}You got it right. My brother said that the gig pays pretty well, and he invited me to come along.
{character:Ichihime}The Shirogane siblings are really diligent. They've been a great help, nyaa!
{character:Ichihime}I'm the deity of this shrine, nyaa!
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Deity?
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}That's what she said. Well, to put it simply, she's our employer.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Well, what a nice goddess we have here. The student council president and middle school treasurer of our academy will surely thank you for your help.
{character:Ai Hayasaka}(Why does she sound like she's introducing her family members...?)
{character:Mai Aihara}Mi... Mr. Miyuki! Are you available? We've been swamped with customers!
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Sorry. All this chatting made me forget my work. On my way, Miss Aihara.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}...Hayasaka, I've changed my mind.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Come on, Mr. President. Let's duel!
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Shinomiya... Why the sudden change of heart?

{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Well, I feel like I have to try it for myself since I'm already here. But it'd be really lame to just play a typical game. How about... Ah, I got it! If you lose, Mr. President, you'll stop working here starting today?
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Huh... But why?!
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Then it's decided. Priestess Aihara, how about you join in the fun, too?
{character:Mai Aihara}Ah... M-me? I'm not very good at it. I'll join in if you won't mind that too much.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Hold your horses! Shinomiya, I haven't agreed to your wild idea yet!
{character:Ai Hayasaka}Mr. President, don't overthink it. C'mon and play! Don't worry. All you need is a win, and you can keep your job!
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}That's not wrong, but the situation doesn't seem to be fair to me!
{character:Ai Hayasaka}Jeez, who thought a top student like you might shy away from playing a couple of girls?
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Hmm... Ha... Hahaha! What a joke! A man like Miyuki Shirogane doesn't shy away from any challenge!
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}(Besides, it's a duel between Kaguya and me, so there's no reason to back off.)
{character:Ai Hayasaka}(My lady, the fish has bitten the bait. My duty ends here.)
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(Well done, Hayasaka. I'll take it from here.)
The master and the servant finished their communication with mere eye contact. Such deep telepathy is as common as daily conversations between the duo.

{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(I know the president won't easily fall for her, but it's simply too dangerous to leave a hormonal teenage boy here with a lady who has such huge "assets"... I shall remove the threat, myself!)
Deep within Kaguya's heart, she couldn't stand Miyuki staying in this maiden's land, not even for a second!

{character:Miyuki Shirogane}(This job pays really well. I've gotta keep it... Oh yeah, I forget about Kaguya's punishment when she loses... I'll borrow the cat ears from Ichihime and the priestess outfit from Miss Aihara for her. But I wonder if Kaguya actually would actually fit into that outfit?)

In the duel concerning his livelihood, Miyuki Shirogane had his priorities straight, just like a typical boy in his teenage years.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Sorry for keeping you waiting, valued customer. Here's your coke... Huh? Shinomiya and Hayasaka, what brings you two here?
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Shinomiya, allow me to introduce you to Ichihime. She's the...
Kaguya recently realized that Miyuki Shirogane seemed more exhausted than usual.

It's not so much a secret that Miyuki is working relentlessly after school to support his family, and Kaguya is well aware of this. But she realized that Miyuki has also been doubling down on his coffee consumption for quite a few days now, which is very unusual.
To find out the truth, Kaguya tried asking indirectly a couple of times, but to no avail.
